### The University of Jordan
#### University of Jordan

---

**Course Title:** Company in Islamic Jurisprudence and Its Contemporary Applications  
**Number of Credit Hours:** 3  
**Article Number:** 0406904  
**Pre-requisite:** - ( )

**Description:**  
This article deals with the meaning of the company in Islamic jurisprudence, the evidence of its legitimacy, its pillars and general conditions, and the types of companies in Islamic jurisprudence (Lanan Company, Mudaraba Company, Al-Abdan Company, The business company, the faces company, the bargaining company). It covers the types of companies in law, the joint-stock company and its jurisprudential roots, multinational companies and cross-border companies, contemporary applications of companies in Islamic banks and economic institutions, and the role of companies in economic development and investment.

---

**Course Title:** Jurisprudential Theories  
**Number of Credit Hours:** 3  
**Article Number:** 0406901  
**Pre-requisite:** - ( )

**Description:**  
This material deals with the definition of jurisprudential theory, its origins, development, importance, methods of constructing it, its sources, types, and the difference between the science of jurisprudential theories. It addresses fundamental differences, jurisprudential rules, controls, similarities, counterparts, and purposeful rules.

The course also studies the most prominent jurisprudential theories, including: the theory of right, the theory of emergency circumstances, the theory of motive in contracts, the theory of the contract, necessity theory, extinction theory, ownership theory, and Islamic politics and governance, with an explanation of the provisions of these theories and their applications compared to man-made laws.
